relationships.subject: Tetraponera rufonigra venom
relationships.evidence_quote: The COX-2 level of the ant venom-treated cells was significantly increased in a time-dependent manner compared with the control group (p < 0.05)

relationships.subject: Tetraponera rufonigra venom
relationships.evidence_quote: The amount of the secreted PGE2 in the venom treated cells was significantly increased in a time-dependent manner compared to the non-treated control (Figure 6).

relationships.subject: Tetraponera rufonigra venom
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of mPGES-1 gene was significantly upregulated after the treatment for 12 h (Figure 7).

key_findings: T. rufonigra venom contains PLA2 and induces COX-2, PGE2 and mPGES-1 in RAW 264.7 macrophages
